scheme_name: Rajasthan Mukhyamantri Yuva Sambal Yojana (Unemployment Allowance)
description: Monthly unemployment allowance for educated, jobless youth while they search for work.
Eligible: Rajasthan domicile, age up to 30 years (35 for women/SC/ST/OBC/PwD), family income below ₹2 lakh/year.
Must hold at least Bachelor's degree, be registered with Employment Exchange, and not be in any job/self-employment.
Maximum 2 members per family can receive allowance simultaneously.
channel_partner_name: District Employment Exchange Office + CSC centre, Rajasthan
maximum_benefit: Monthly unemployment allowance (amount varies, typically ₹1,000–₹3,000 per month)

description: Interest-free loan up to ₹10 lakh for youth to start new businesses.
Eligible: Rajasthan domicile, age 18–45 years, family income below ₹2.5 lakh/year.
Priority to women, SC/ST, OBC youth.
100% interest subsidy on bank loans.
documents_required: Educational qualification certificates (minimum 8th/10th/12th pass as applicable)
channel_partner_name: State Bank of Bikaner and Jaipur (now part of State Bank of India)
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Up to ₹10 lakh interest-free loan

scheme_name: Rajasthan Nari Shakti Prashikshan Evam Kaushal Samvardhan Yojana
description: Free skill training and empowerment programme for women and girls.
Eligible: Women/girls, age 18–45 years, Rajasthan domicile.
18% seats reserved for SC, 12% for ST.
Includes training, stipend, and toolkit support.
channel_partner_name: District Women and Child Development Office, Rajasthan
maximum_benefit: Free skill training + ₹500 monthly stipend + ₹1,000 toolkit support

scheme_name: Rajasthan Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
description: Scholarship for SC/ST students studying after Class 10 (Class 11/12, diploma, graduation, PG, etc.).
Covers tuition fees, exam fees, and maintenance allowance.
Eligible: SC/ST students, Rajasthan domicile, family income below ₹2.5 lakh/year.
Must be studying in recognised institutions.
documents_required: Current year admission proof and fee receipt
Jan Aadhaar or Bhamashah ID card
channel_partner_name: District Social Justice Office + SSO Portal, Rajasthan
maximum_benefit: Full tuition/exam fees + maintenance allowance (varies by course, typically ₹10,000–₹60,000 per year)

scheme_name: Rajasthan Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme for SC Students
description: Monthly fellowship for SC students pursuing higher education (graduation, PG, research).
Eligible: SC students, Rajasthan domicile, family income below ₹2.5 lakh/year.
Provides ₹15,000 per month for up to 3 years.
Merit-based selection.
channel_partner_name: District Social Justice Office, Rajasthan
maximum_benefit: ₹15,000 per month for up to 3 years

scheme_name: Rajasthan Charm Prashikshan Yojana (Leather Craft Training)
description: Free leather craft training to promote skills and self-employment.
Eligible: Rajasthan domicile, age 18–35 years, literate (minimum 8th pass preferred).
Provides training, ₹500 monthly stipend, and ₹1,000 toolkit.
Priority to SC/ST/OBC candidates.
channel_partner_name: District Industries Centre (DIC), Rajasthan
maximum_benefit: Free training + ₹500 monthly stipend + ₹1,000 toolkit

scheme_name: Punjab Chief Minister's Skill Development Mission
description: Free skill training and placement support for youth.
Eligible: Punjab domicile, age 18–35 years, priority to SC/ST/OBC, women.
Training in various trades with stipend during training.
Placement assistance after training completion.
channel_partner_name: Punjab Skill Development Mission Office, Chandigarh
maximum_benefit: Free skill training + monthly stipend during training + placement support

scheme_name: Haryana Chief Minister's Yuva Udyami Scheme
description: Interest subsidy on bank loans for youth entrepreneurs.
Eligible: Haryana domicile, age 21–45 years, family income below ₹5 lakh/year.
Loan up to ₹10 lakh with interest subsidy.
Priority to women, SC/ST, OBC youth.
channel_partner_name: Punjab National Bank
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Up to ₹10 lakh loan with interest subsidy

description: Financial assistance for youth to start self-employment ventures.
Eligible: Uttarakhand domicile, age 21–45 years, family income below ₹3 lakh/year.
Subsidy up to 35% on bank loans.
Priority to women, SC/ST, OBC youth.
channel_partner_name: State Bank of India
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Up to ₹10 lakh loan with 35% subsidy

scheme_name: Himachal Pradesh Chief Minister's Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana
description: Financial assistance for women's self-help groups and individual women entrepreneurs.
Eligible: Women residents of Himachal Pradesh, age 18–59 years.
Provides corpus fund for SHGs and individual loans with subsidy.
Priority to SC/ST women.
channel_partner_name: Himachal Pradesh Gramin Bank
npa_percentage: Approx. 5.3% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Regional Rural Banks)
maximum_benefit: Corpus fund for SHGs + individual loans up to ₹5 lakh with subsidy

description: Financial assistance for SC/ST/BC women aged 45–60 years.
Eligible: Women, age 45–60 years, from SC/ST/BC categories, Andhra Pradesh domicile.
Provides ₹18,750 per year for 4 years (total ₹75,000).
Aim: economic empowerment of women.
channel_partner_name: District Rural Development Agency (DRDA) Office, Andhra Pradesh
maximum_benefit: ₹18,750 per year for 4 years (total ₹75,000)

description: Annual financial assistance for auto/taxi drivers owning their vehicles.
Eligible: Auto/taxi drivers, Andhra Pradesh domicile, owning their vehicles.
Provides ₹10,000 per year.
Priority to SC/ST/BC drivers.
channel_partner_name: District Transport Office + CSC centre, Andhra Pradesh
maximum_benefit: ₹10,000 per year

description: Stipend-based apprenticeship for educated youth.
Eligible: Karnataka domicile, age 21–35 years, graduate/diploma holder.
Provides monthly stipend during apprenticeship period.
Priority to women, SC/ST, OBC youth.
channel_partner_name: District Industries Centre (DIC), Karnataka
maximum_benefit: Monthly stipend during apprenticeship (typically ₹5,000–₹10,000 per month)

description: Scholarship for SC/ST students studying after Class 10.
Covers tuition fees, exam fees, and maintenance allowance.
Eligible: SC/ST students, Karnataka domicile, family income below ₹2.5 lakh/year.
Must be studying in recognised institutions.
documents_required: Current year admission proof and fee receipt
channel_partner_name: District Social Welfare Office + Karnataka Scholarship Portal
maximum_benefit: Full tuition/exam fees + maintenance allowance (varies by course)

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Vishwakarma Kaushal Samman (PM Vishwakarma)
description: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople (Vishwakarmas) with credit, skill training, and market linkage.
Eligible: Artisans/craftspeople from 18 traditional trades (carpenter, blacksmith, potter, etc.).
Provides skill training, toolkit incentive, and concessional loans.
Priority to women, SC/ST artisans.
documents_required: Proof of engagement in traditional trade (certificate from local authority/panchayat)
channel_partner_name: Bank of India
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Skill training + toolkit incentive (₹15,000) + concessional loan up to ₹3 lakh

description: Skill development programme offering free training and certification.
Eligible: Indian citizens, age 18–45 years, priority to women, SC/ST, OBC.
Provides skill training, assessment, and certification.
Monetary reward on successful completion of training.
channel_partner_name: PMKVY Training Centre + CSC centre
maximum_benefit: Free skill training + monetary reward (₹5,000–₹20,000 depending on course)

description: Financial assistance for rehabilitation of persons with disabilities.
Eligible: Persons with 40%+ disability, priority to SC/ST, women.
Provides grants to NGOs for running rehabilitation centres.
Covers education, training, and skill development for disabled persons.
channel_partner_name: District Social Welfare Office, State Disability Commissioner Office
maximum_benefit: Free education/training through empanelled NGOs; grants vary by programme

description: Scholarship for meritorious students from economically weaker sections.
Eligible: Students studying in Class 9, family income below ₹3.5 lakh/year.
Provides ₹12,000 per year (₹1,000 per month) for 4 years (Class 9–12).
Selection through state-level examination.
channel_partner_name: District Education Office + School, NSP portal
maximum_benefit: ₹12,000 per year for 4 years (Class 9–12)

description: Scholarship for SC students studying in Class 9 and 10.
Eligible: SC students, family income below ₹2.5 lakh/year.
Covers admission fees, tuition fees, maintenance allowance, and other expenses.
Implemented through states/UTs.
channel_partner_name: District Social Welfare Office + School, NSP portal
maximum_benefit: Admission/tuition fees + maintenance allowance (varies, typically ₹5,000–₹15,000 per year)

description: Scholarship for ST students studying in Class 9 and 10.
Eligible: ST students, family income below ₹2.5 lakh/year.
Covers admission fees, tuition fees, maintenance allowance, and other expenses.
Implemented through states/UTs.
channel_partner_name: District Tribal Welfare Office + School, NSP portal
maximum_benefit: Admission/tuition fees + maintenance allowance (varies, typically ₹5,000–₹15,000 per year)

description: Scholarship for ST students studying after Class 10.
Covers tuition fees, exam fees, and maintenance allowance.
Eligible: ST students, family income below ₹2.5 lakh/year.
Must be studying in recognised institutions.
documents_required: Current year admission proof and fee receipt
channel_partner_name: District Tribal Welfare Office + NSP portal
maximum_benefit: Full tuition/exam fees + maintenance allowance (varies by course)

description: Fellowship for SC students pursuing M.Phil and Ph.D.
Eligible: SC students, cleared UGC-NET/CSIR-NET or equivalent, family income below ₹6 lakh/year.
Provides ₹31,000 per month (Junior Research Fellowship) and ₹35,000 per month (Senior Research Fellowship).
Duration: up to 5 years.
channel_partner_name: University/Institution + NSP portal
maximum_benefit: ₹31,000–₹35,000 per month for up to 5 years

description: Fellowship for ST students pursuing M.Phil and Ph.D.
Eligible: ST students, cleared UGC-NET/CSIR-NET or equivalent, family income below ₹6 lakh/year.
Provides ₹31,000 per month (JRF) and ₹35,000 per month (SRF).
Duration: up to 5 years.
channel_partner_name: University/Institution + NSP portal
maximum_benefit: ₹31,000–₹35,000 per month for up to 5 years

scheme_name: Babu Jagjivan Ram Chhatrawas Yojana (Hostel for SC Students)
description: Construction of hostels for SC students to promote higher education.
Eligible: SC students admitted to recognised institutions.
Provides subsidized hostel accommodation.
Implemented through state governments and institutions.
channel_partner_name: Institution Hostel Office + District Social Welfare Office
maximum_benefit: Subsidized hostel accommodation (value varies by institution)

description: Comprehensive development scheme for SC/ST communities in Kerala.
Eligible: SC/ST residents of Kerala, priority to women and youth.
Provides housing, education, skill training, and livelihood support.
Implemented through tribal development department.
channel_partner_name: District Tribal Development Office, Kerala
maximum_benefit: Housing assistance + education support + skill training + livelihood support (varies by component)
